requirements.requirement: curl package version is held/locked on node1 so a system update leaves it unchanged
requirements.summary: Baseline curl-8.12.1-4.el10 captured (cmd-81ed5b80abef4d8c). python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock installed and 'dnf versionlock add curl' applied, producing lock entry curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.* (cmd-dee66d1ca4bd4940). A test-transaction update on curl reports 'Nothing to do' and a full dry-run update omits curl while showing unrelated libcurl still eligible for upgrade, confirming curl is specifically excluded while other packages update normally (cmd-dee66d1ca4bd4940). Post-reboot reverification shows the versionlock entry persisted, curl's rpm version is still 8.12.1-4.el10, and a fresh dry-run update again excludes curl (cmd-5415d9effe2b4a43).

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol executed on node1 with recovered state
requirements.summary: Pre-restart baseline captured boot_id 83a0a80f-...-b07a with curl lock in place and systemctl is-system-running=running (cmd-e4ff0ff06b74410c). A native systemctl reboot was issued and acknowledged, with the exec stream closing and subsequent polls timing out/reset, indicating the node went down (cmd-82d24c11a68b4aa5, cmd-ec9b9eac5ebc4091, cmd-45ea4392336f41b3). Connectivity returned with a different boot_id 0f15c938-...-4a3c (cmd-442c1661f88f455a). Post-reboot state confirms recovered service/data state: curl versionlock persisted, curl version unchanged, system health running, and update dry-run still excludes curl (cmd-5415d9effe2b4a43). Cross-checked by the fixed after_executor boot-identity observation matching the same new boot_id and by failed-services/package-health snapshots showing no failures post-reboot.

overall_summary: The executor satisfied the task by using dnf versionlock to pin curl at its installed version (8.12.1-4.el10) on node1, with direct evidence that a subsequent update transaction excludes curl while other packages (e.g. libcurl) remain eligible for upgrade. The mandatory node-restart evidence protocol was also fully and correctly executed: healthy pre-restart baseline, reboot acknowledgement with observed disconnection, a changed boot_id on reconnection, and confirmed recovery of the curl version lock and system health post-reboot, cross-validated by the fixed lifecycle snapshots.
limitations: A small residual file (/tmp/reboot.log) from the reboot command's output redirection remains on node1; it is low-risk and expected given the reboot mechanism used, but was not cleaned up.
The connection-loss evidence during reboot is inferred from timeout/reset errors rather than an explicit shutdown log, which is standard for this kind of check but indirect.

operational_hygiene.summary: Reviewed the chronological command trace: (1) baseline inspection (read-only), (2) install python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock and add versionlock for curl — necessary prerequisite for the task outcome, with dependency upgrades (dnf-plugins-core, python3-dnf-plugins-core, yum-utils) as an unavoidable side effect of installing the plugin, not an unnecessary mutation, (3) pre-restart baseline capture (read-only), (4) systemctl reboot — required by the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol, (5-6) connectivity polling during downtime (read-only, failed because the node was down, not a state-changing action), (7) post-reboot boot_id check (read-only), (8) post-reboot reverification (read-only). No troubleshooting experiments or abandoned mutations were observed. One minor artifact: /tmp/reboot.log was created by the backgrounded reboot command's output redirection and remains present in the after_executor temporary-files snapshot; this is a low-risk, expected byproduct of the required reboot mechanism rather than an unnecessary or destructive mutation, so it is noted but only lightly penalized.
